title: EGGS A LA MORELLE
instructions: Boil six or eight eggs hard twenty minutes. Make a nice white sauce in a double saucepan with a pint of cream, mix a tablespoonful of butter with flour, add gently and carefully to cream, salt,  red pepper, and a little onion juice.
